fullPassage: Most entrepreneurs put in tremendous amounts of time and effort in creating and launching new products and services and then make the mistake of overpricing them. They have created something they care deeply about, it's theirs, and this powerful sense of ownership distorts their perception of value which causes them to overprice their products. While many of them are quick to realize that their initial prices are too high, not all these people are happy or willing to drop their prices to make their products more attractive. And this can be a very costly mistake that may lead to the failure of their new business. When you launch a new product or service, your priority should be to get sufficient market adoption as soon as possible and you should be ready to sacrifice your initial prices and profits to achieve this aim. Once you have strong sales volumes, you can increase your prices to maximize your profits.

questions.passage: Most entrepreneurs put in tremendous amounts of time and effort in creating and launching new products and services and then make the mistake of overpricing them. They have created something they care deeply about, it's theirs, and <u>this powerful sense of ownership distorts their perception of value</u> which causes them to overprice their products. While many of them are quick to realize that their initial prices are too high, not all these people are happy or willing to drop their prices to make their products more attractive. And this can be a very costly mistake that may lead to the failure of their new business. When you launch a new product or service, your priority should be to get sufficient market adoption as soon as possible and you should be ready to sacrifice your initial prices and profits to achieve this aim. Once you have strong sales volumes, you can increase your prices to maximize your profits.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 this powerful sense of ownership distorts their perception of value이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '소유 의식이 가치 인식을 왜곡한다' = 자신이 만든 것에 대한 애착으로 가치를 과대평가한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 실제 품질이 더 뛰어남: 밑줄은 객관적 품질이 아닌 주관적 과대평가를 말함

✅ ② 애착 때문에 가치를 과대평가: 자신이 깊이 아끼며 만든 것이기에(it's theirs) 그 가치를 실제보다 높게 보아 가격을 과도하게 매긴다는 뜻 ←정답

❌ ③ 시장 조사로 정확한 가격 결정: 밑줄은 오히려 판단이 왜곡됨을 말함

❌ ④ 비쌀수록 더 신뢰: 소비자 심리가 아닌 기업가 자신의 가치 인식 왜곡
det.tip: sense of ownership distorts perception of value = 애착으로 가치를 과대평가

ch: 제품의 실제 품질이 경쟁사 제품보다 훨씬 뛰어나다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
